chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Abdul Rahman ibn Abu Najran, from Al-A'ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who marries the woman and copulates with her, then she claims upon him for her dower, he (peace be upon him) said: 'When he copulates with her, it demolishes the immediate (dower).'

key_terms.مَهْرُ: Dower or bridal gift given by the husband to the wife
key_terms.يَدْخُلُ بِهَا: To copulate with her; consummation of marriage

ai.seo_question: What is the effect of consummation on the wife's claim for immediate dower in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this ruling from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Baqir (AS) clarifies that consummation (dakhala biha) serves as the definitive legal trigger for the husband's obligation to pay the immediate dower (al-mahr al-mu'ajjal), effectively nullifying any prior dispute or claim regarding its status. This principle underscores the significance of physical intimacy in Islamic jurisprudence as the event that crystallizes financial rights, ensuring the wife's security upon marriage completion. The term 'demolishes the immediate' signifies that the act renders the immediate portion due and indisputable, shifting the legal focus from potentiality to actuality.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Najran, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>

regarding the man who married the woman and copulated with her, then she claimed upon him for her dower. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When he copulated with her, it demolished the immediate (dower) (i.e. rendered it irrelevant)’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Najran from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said

the following: “About the case of a man who marries a woman and goes to bed with her, then she asks for payment of mahr (dower), abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘His going to bed with her destroys immediate payability of mahr (dower) which was for immediate payment.’”
